Information on this page is accurate for version v.821 and may differ from the current information and changes in v.910.12(*).

Medicine


Medicine — used to treat diseases and injuries, and also used to reduce harmful effects on vital signs. In this game, almost all drug names are fictitious.

Receiving medications

  • Most medicines can be found in medical institutions (pharmacies, clinics, hospitals), corpses of hermits, and also made independently in the "Health" item crafting tab.
  • Medicines can be obtained individually by purchasing them from merchants.
  • Cigarettes can be found everywhere.

Notes

  • In early versions of the game, all the "pills" had the same pills in different colors: red, orange, blue, purple, gradient, etc.
  • However, even earlier, for example, in version v.339, all pills (even Activated charcoal) had the same icon.
  • In the following versions, all the pills received their own icons, made according to the template "two white pills and a coloured capsule in front of them." The colour of the capsule made it possible to understand what kind of medicine it was (for example, in the image of Chlorcystamine, there was a completely purple capsule).
